extra_vocab.en: things you throw away because you do not want them
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於辦公室清潔、公共場所標示與環保的情境。trash 是美式說法，英式多用 rubbish。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: trash 當名詞是不可數，不加 s，也不說 a trash；要數量時用 a bag of trash。

example.en: He trashes old files every Friday to free up space.
example.zh: 他每週五都會丟掉舊檔案來騰出空間。

example.en: Someone trashed the draft before I could save it.
example.zh: 在我存檔之前，有人把草稿丟掉了。

example.en: They are trashing outdated brochures from the storage room.
example.zh: 他們正在丟掉儲藏室裡過時的宣傳冊。

example.en: Please take out the trash before you leave tonight.
example.zh: 今晚離開前請把垃圾拿出去倒。

example.en: Put your empty cups in the trash can by the door.
example.zh: 請把空杯子丟進門邊的垃圾桶。

example.en: The cleaners bring extra trash bags every Monday morning.
example.zh: 清潔人員每週一早上都會帶來額外的垃圾袋。

example.en: Trash collection is every Tuesday and Friday morning.
example.zh: 垃圾收集時間是每週二和週五早上。

examples.en: There is too much trash on the street near the station.
examples.zh: 車站附近的街上有太多垃圾。

examples.en: Do not leave your trash in the meeting room.
examples.zh: 請不要把你的垃圾留在會議室裡。

examples.en: Our company is working to reduce the amount of trash we make.
examples.zh: 我們公司正在努力減少產生的垃圾量。

similar.diff: rubbish 是英式說法；美式英文多說 trash 或 garbage。

example.en: Please put your rubbish in the bin outside the office.
example.zh: 請把你的垃圾丟進辦公室外面的垃圾桶。

similar.diff: waste 較正式，指工廠、公司產生的廢棄物或浪費；trash 較口語，指日常垃圾。

example.en: The factory must reduce waste to save money.
example.zh: 工廠必須減少廢棄物以節省成本。

example.en: Employees recycle paper and plastic bottles at the office.
example.zh: 員工在辦公室回收紙張和塑膠瓶。

example.en: The recycling bin is next to the printer on the second floor.
example.zh: 回收桶在二樓的印表機旁邊。

example.en: Please put all your trash in the bin outside.
example.zh: 請把你所有的垃圾丟進外面的垃圾桶。

example.en: I accidentally trashed the email that contained the contract.
example.zh: 我不小心把含有合約的電子郵件丟進了垃圾桶。

extra_vocab.en: for a short time only, not forever
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於公告與通知，如暫停營業、暫時關閉、設備暫時無法使用、暫時由某人代理。常放在 closed、unavailable、out of service 前面。

example.en: The gym is temporarily closed for cleaning today.
example.zh: 健身房今天因清潔而暫時關閉。

example.en: This product is temporarily unavailable in our online store.
example.zh: 這項產品在我們的網路商店暫時無法購買。

example.en: The elevator is temporarily out of service until noon.
example.zh: 電梯暫停服務，直到中午。

example.en: We will temporarily suspend deliveries during the storm.
example.zh: 暴風雨期間，我們會暫時停止送貨。

examples.en: Our office will temporarily move to the third floor.
examples.zh: 我們的辦公室將暫時搬到三樓。

examples.en: Ms. Park is temporarily taking over the sales team.
examples.zh: Park 女士暫時接管業務團隊。

examples.en: I am temporarily out of the office and will reply Monday.
examples.zh: 我目前暫時不在辦公室，星期一會回覆。

confusable.diff: permanently 是「永久地」，和 temporarily 意思相反。

example.en: The store has permanently closed its downtown branch.
example.zh: 這家店已永久關閉市中心的分店。

similar.diff: for the time being 較口語，意思是「目前先這樣，直到有新安排」，常放句尾。

example.en: We will use the old system for the time being.
example.zh: 目前我們先繼續使用舊系統。

example.en: We are currently hiring two new sales assistants in Taipei.
example.zh: 我們目前在台北招募兩名新的業務助理。

example.en: Mr. Chen briefly explained the new rules to us.
example.zh: Chen 先生向我們簡短說明了新規定。

derived.link: temporarily 的 -ily 還原成 -y 就是形容詞 temporary，像 happily → happy

extra_vocab.en: a piece of cloth or paper used to dry your body or hands
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於飯店客房、健身房、游泳池與清潔用品的情境，如 bath towel、paper towel。

example.en: The hotel changes the towels in every room each morning.
example.zh: 飯店每天早上都會更換每間客房的毛巾。

example.en: Fresh bath towels are placed in each guest room daily.
example.zh: 每間客房每天都會放置新的浴巾。

example.en: Please use a paper towel to dry your hands.
example.zh: 請用紙巾把手擦乾。

example.en: Guests may ask for extra towels at the front desk.
example.zh: 客人可以到櫃檯索取額外的毛巾。

examples.en: The hotel provides a clean towel for every guest.
examples.zh: 飯店為每位客人提供乾淨的毛巾。

examples.en: Please bring your own towel to the swimming pool.
examples.zh: 請自備毛巾到游泳池。

examples.en: Used towels should be put in the basket by the door.
examples.zh: 用過的毛巾應放進門邊的籃子裡。

confusable.diff: tower 是塔或高樓，towel 是毛巾，兩字只差最後一個字母。

example.en: The company moved into a new office tower downtown.
example.zh: 公司搬進了市中心一棟新的辦公大樓。

example.en: The hotel gives each guest free soap and shampoo.
example.zh: 飯店為每位客人提供免費的肥皂和洗髮精。

example.en: The hotel laundry returns your clothes within one day.
example.zh: 飯店的洗衣服務會在一天內送回您的衣物。

extra_vocab.en: a soft, round, red fruit that people eat as a vegetable
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於餐廳菜單、食材採購、農產品與食品公司的情境，如 tomato sauce、tomato soup。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: tomato 的複數是 tomatoes（加 -es），不是 tomatos；potato 也一樣。

example.en: The farm sells fresh tomatoes to local restaurants every week.
example.zh: 這座農場每週向當地餐廳販售新鮮番茄。

example.en: A fresh tomato adds color and flavor to this salad.
example.zh: 一顆新鮮番茄為這份沙拉增添色彩和風味。

example.en: The restaurant makes its own tomato sauce every morning.
example.zh: 這家餐廳每天早上自己製作番茄醬汁。

example.en: Today's special is a bowl of tomato soup and bread.
example.zh: 今日特餐是一碗番茄湯和麵包。

examples.en: All our sandwiches come with lettuce and sliced tomato.
examples.zh: 我們所有的三明治都附有生菜和切片番茄。

examples.en: Tomato prices rose sharply after the heavy rain last month.
examples.zh: 上個月的大雨過後，番茄價格大幅上漲。

examples.en: Cut the tomato into small pieces before adding the cheese.
examples.zh: 加起司之前，請先把番茄切成小塊。

confusable.diff: potato 是馬鈴薯，tomato 是番茄，兩字拼法和發音很像。

example.en: Each lunch set includes a baked potato and a salad.
example.zh: 每份午餐套餐都包含一顆烤馬鈴薯和一份沙拉。

example.en: The store sells fresh vegetables and fruit every day.
example.zh: 這家店每天販售新鮮的蔬菜和水果。

example.en: The pasta comes with a choice of three sauces.
example.zh: 這道義大利麵可以選擇三種醬汁。

extra_vocab.en: a flat object used for carrying or holding things
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於餐廳、飯店客房服務、辦公室影印機的紙匣與文件盤，是日常生活常見的物品。

example.en: The waiters carried trays of drinks to the guests.
example.zh: 服務生端著幾盤飲料送給客人。

example.en: Please place the cups on the serving tray carefully.
example.zh: 請小心地把杯子放在托盤上。

example.en: The printer stopped because the paper tray was empty.
example.zh: 因為紙匣是空的，印表機停了下來。

example.en: Please put your tray table up before landing.
example.zh: 降落前請把小桌板收起來。

examples.en: Return your tray to the counter after you finish eating.
examples.zh: 用完餐後請把托盤歸還到櫃檯。

examples.en: A staff member brought breakfast to my room on a tray.
examples.zh: 服務人員用托盤把早餐送到我的房間。

examples.en: Please put the signed forms in the tray on my desk.
examples.zh: 請把簽好的表格放在我桌上的文件盤裡。

confusable.diff: try 是動詞「嘗試」，tray 是名詞「托盤」，兩字只差一個字母。
confusable.usage: try 是動詞，後面接 to V 或名詞；tray 是名詞，母音發音也不同（/traɪ/ 與 /treɪ/）。

example.en: We will try to finish the report by Thursday noon.
example.zh: 我們會試著在星期四中午前完成報告。

example.en: The server placed a clean plate in front of each guest.
example.zh: 服務生在每位客人面前放了一個乾淨的盤子。

example.en: Room service brought a cart with coffee and fruit.
example.zh: 客房服務推來了一台載著咖啡和水果的推車。

senses.en: a flat object used to carry food and drinks

example.en: The waiter carried a tray of coffee to our table.
example.zh: 服務生端著一盤咖啡來到我們的桌邊。

senses.en: a flat box that holds paper or documents
senses.distinguish: 在辦公室、影印機或桌面的情境中，tray 指放紙張或文件的盤子或匣子。

example.en: Please add more paper to the tray on the copy machine.
example.zh: 請在影印機的紙匣裡補充更多紙張。

extra_vocab.en: the act of changing words into another language
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於合約、說明書、網站、客服與翻譯服務的情境，指書面的翻譯工作或翻好的文件。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 表示翻成某種語言用 translation into + 語言；從某種語言翻出用 from，如 a translation from Korean into English。

example.en: Our company offers translations in over twenty languages.
example.zh: 我們公司提供超過二十種語言的翻譯。

example.en: The translation service can finish the contract in two days.
example.zh: 翻譯服務可以在兩天內完成這份合約。

example.en: A small translation error caused a big misunderstanding.
example.zh: 一個小小的翻譯錯誤造成了很大的誤會。

example.en: Machine translation is fast, but it may miss the tone.
example.zh: 機器翻譯很快，但可能會漏掉語氣。

examples.en: Please send the Japanese translation of the manual by Monday.
examples.zh: 請在星期一前寄出說明書的日文翻譯。

examples.en: I need a translation of this letter before the meeting.
examples.zh: 我在會議前需要這封信的翻譯。

examples.en: The website offers an English translation of every page.
examples.zh: 這個網站為每一頁都提供英文翻譯。

confusable.diff: transition 是轉變、過渡；translation 是翻譯，兩字開頭相同。

example.en: The transition to the new system took about two months.
example.zh: 轉換到新系統大約花了兩個月。

confusable.diff: transaction 是交易；translation 是翻譯，兩字開頭相同、長度也像。

example.en: Each transaction is recorded in our system automatically.
example.zh: 每筆交易都會自動記錄在我們的系統裡。

similar.diff: interpretation 在這裡指口譯，也就是現場口頭翻譯；translation 是書面翻譯。

example.en: The conference offers live interpretation in three languages.
example.zh: 這場會議提供三種語言的現場口譯。

example.en: The user manual is available in five different languages.
example.zh: 這份使用手冊有五種不同語言的版本。

example.en: The interpreter helped us talk with the Korean buyers.
example.zh: 口譯員協助我們和韓國買家溝通。

derived.link: translation 去掉 -ion 就是動詞 translate，像 educate → education

senses.en: the act of changing words into another language

example.en: Translation of the full contract will take three days.
example.zh: 翻譯整份合約需要三天的時間。

senses.en: a text that has been changed into another language
senses.distinguish: 談工作、費用、時間時指翻譯這件事；談附件、檔案時指已經翻好的內容。

example.en: The Spanish translation is attached to this email.
example.zh: 西班牙文譯本附在這封電子郵件裡。

extra_vocab.en: a long passage under the ground or through a mountain
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於交通公告、路況、公路與捷運工程的情境，如隧道封閉、穿過隧道、興建隧道。

example.en: Several tunnels connect the city to the airport.
example.zh: 有好幾條隧道把市區連接到機場。

example.en: Traffic stops at the tunnel entrance during rush hour.
example.zh: 尖峰時段，車流會在隧道入口處停下來。

example.en: The train goes through the tunnel in about five minutes.
example.zh: 火車大約五分鐘就能穿過這條隧道。

example.en: Tunnel construction will start next spring near the harbor.
example.zh: 隧道工程將在明年春天於港口附近開工。

examples.en: The tunnel is closed tonight for cleaning and repairs.
examples.zh: 隧道今晚因清潔和維修而封閉。

examples.en: Use the tunnel to avoid the busy bridge downtown.
examples.zh: 請走隧道，避開市中心壅塞的橋。

examples.en: Engineers spent three years building the tunnel under the bay.
examples.zh: 工程師花了三年時間興建海灣下的隧道。

confusable.diff: channel 是頻道、管道或海峽，結尾 -nel 和 tunnel 很像；tunnel 是隧道。

example.en: The company launched a new channel on social media.
example.zh: 公司在社群媒體上開設了一個新頻道。

similar.diff: underpass 是從道路下方穿過的短通道；tunnel 通常更長，穿過山或河流。

example.en: Walkers use the underpass to cross the busy road.
example.zh: 行人利用地下道穿越繁忙的馬路。

example.en: The new bridge will shorten the trip by ten minutes.
example.zh: 新橋會讓行程縮短十分鐘。

example.en: Take the northern route to avoid the construction.
example.zh: 請走北邊的路線，避開施工路段。

extra_vocab.en: the act of getting control of a company or group
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於企業新聞、併購與管理層變動的情境，指一家公司買下另一家公司，或有人接手管理。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 名詞是一個字 takeover；動詞片語是兩個字 take over（The firm took over its rival）。

example.en: Two takeovers in one year changed the company's culture.
example.zh: 一年內發生兩次收購，改變了公司的文化。

example.en: The board fought a hostile takeover by a larger rival.
example.zh: 董事會抵抗了一家較大競爭對手的敵意收購。

example.en: The firm made a takeover bid worth two billion dollars.
example.zh: 這家公司提出了價值二十億美元的收購出價。

example.en: Shareholders will vote on the takeover offer next Monday.
example.zh: 股東將在下週一對收購提案進行投票。

examples.en: News of the takeover pushed the share price up sharply.
examples.zh: 收購的消息讓股價大幅上漲。

examples.en: After the takeover, all employees will keep their current jobs.
examples.zh: 收購之後，所有員工都會保留現在的工作。

examples.en: Analysts say the takeover will make the company more competitive.
examples.zh: 分析師說這次收購會讓公司更有競爭力。

confusable.diff: overtake 是動詞「超越、趕上」；takeover 是名詞「收購」。
confusable.usage: overtake 是動詞，takeover 是名詞，兩者的字母順序剛好相反。

example.en: Our sales may overtake our main rival's this year.
example.zh: 我們今年的銷售額可能會超過主要對手。

similar.diff: acquisition 較中性，指買下公司或資產；takeover 強調取得控制權，有時帶有敵意。

example.en: The acquisition of the small firm was completed in May.
example.zh: 這家小公司的收購案在五月完成。

similar.diff: merger 是兩家公司合併成一家；takeover 是一家公司取得另一家的控制權。

example.en: The merger of the two banks created a larger company.
example.zh: 兩家銀行合併後，成為一家更大的公司。

example.en: Shareholders will vote on the plan at the annual meeting.
example.zh: 股東將在年度會議上就這項計畫投票。

example.en: Our main competitor just lowered its prices by ten percent.
example.zh: 我們的主要競爭對手剛把價格降低了百分之十。
